snippet.title: Can an AI Beat the CPU in TardiGeddon? (Full Match) | TardiGeddon
snippet.description:
We handed the controls to an AI and asked it one question: can you beat the CPU? It missed with almost every bazooka shot, landed one lovely Raindrop Strike, then blew up its own team. Full match, every shot, even the bad ones.

▶ Play TardiGeddon free in your browser (no download): https://tardigeddon.com/play

TardiGeddon is a free turn-based artillery game starring tardigrades. Walk, aim and fire across maps that blow apart, mind the wind, and be the last tardi standing. Play against the computer, with up to 10 teams on one device, or online with friends.

🎁 Free hat with the current promo code: https://tardigeddon.com/promo-codes
